purpose: Thumbnail-refresh queue. Target = high-retention + low-CTR videos where the thumbnail is the bottleneck (algo would push harder if CTR rose). Hard-swap cooling/stable videos; Test & Compare accelerating / mid-A/B ones.
rule: AVD high + CTR < 3.68% channel avg = thumbnail-capped. Low AVD = retention problem, thumbnail won't fix (skip). CTR at/above avg = thumbnail fine, drop from queue.
